resources.string: No analytics or automatic uploads. Optional debug diagnostic events and recorded Rune input are off by default and stored locally only after you enable them. Input recording requires two confirmations and excludes sensitive and unsupported fields. Exports are manual; your chosen document provider may sync exported copies outside Rune’s control.
Local event types, decisions and bounded counters. No input text, key values, text hashes or editor identity. Off by default; up to 1 MiB.
Optional local text, candidates and decisions from eligible Rune typing. Independent of diagnostic events. Requires two confirmations; up to 4 MiB.
Export each log separately or disable both options and delete local logs.

This debug option records text entered with Rune, its owned context, original words, candidates and actual decisions. Collection starts only in the next fresh normal text session. Passwords, private fields, email, URL, number, phone, date/time and raw editors are excluded. Rune does not read existing editor text or the clipboard. Continue to the local-storage confirmation?

Rune will keep up to 4 MiB of recorded input in private local files, rotating older records. This is an explicit exception to the normal no-input-storage behavior. You can stop recording without confirmation and delete local logs. Nothing is uploaded automatically. Enable recording?
Exports are manual. Your chosen document provider may sync or upload the exported file. Exported copies are outside Rune’s control and are not removed when local logs are deleted.
Disable both and delete local logs
Enabled collection starts at a fresh eligible input session. Queues and files are bounded; some events may be dropped.
Stopping collection; waiting for local writes to finish…
Both options are off and managed local logs have been deleted. Exported copies remain outside Rune.
The operation could not be completed. No completion is claimed. Check the current switches and try again.
